urlText: Town Hall Station Escalator 7 between the concourse and Platform 4 is not available
content:
At Town Hall Station Escalator 7 between the concourse and Platform 4 is temporarily out of service.

From Tuesday 28 January to Sunday 13 April 2025, the escalator connecting the concourse to the middle of Platform 4 (near the lift) will be closed for maintenance work.
Other escalators, stairs (via Platforms 1 and 2) and the lift are available to exit the platform.
Please allow for additional travel time to exit platform 4. 
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9379 4110.
subtitle: Town Hall Station Escalator 7 between the concourse and Platform 4 is not available

urlText: Sydney Domestic Airport Station Lift between the pedestrian tunnel and the concourse is not available
content:
At Sydney Domestic Airport Station Lift between the pedestrian tunnel and the concourse is temporarily out of service.
Lift access at Domestic Airport station is not available until 20 February 2025 due to a lift upgrade. Baggage handlers are on site to assist. If you require mobility assistance you will need to go to International Terminal station. T-Bus services are available between International Airport near the Taxi Rank at arrivals and Domestic Airport outside arrivals at both T2/T3 terminals.
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 8337 8450.

urlText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
content:
The lift on the John Street Square light rail platform towards Central Station is temporarily out of service until further notice.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
Use the stairs,
·        Or use the lift on the opposite platform
 
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
·        Or call 131 500
subtitle: L1 John Street Square lift out of service

properties.smsText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
properties.speechText: The lift on the John Street Square light rail platform towards Central Station is temporarily out of service until further notice. For your safety, do not use even if the doors open. For alternative access, use the stairs if able to, or use the lift on the opposite platform. For urgent assistance, use the Help Point if on the platform, or call 131 500.
